text_simplified: This text discusses the rights of children upon their parents, drawing evidence from Prophetic hadiths and Qur'anic references. It clarifies that the tarbiyah (upbringing) of children and their education are among the most important religious duties. Parents must care for their children and guide them toward goodness.

review_defects.why: The Arabic specifies Qur'anic verses (آيات), while the English uses the broader 'references', which could include non-verse material and loses the specific meaning of revealed verses.
